summary: Iteration 11 verification: three new features (caption strip, Onyx greeting, glow refactor) plus regression on entrance/hub/one-tap judge reset. Backend 4/4 pytest passing on /api/guardian/greeting + /api/tts/<key>.mp3. Frontend 9/9 acceptance checks pass at 390x844 (Chromium auto-picks .webm as expected). Caption strip [data-testid=gateway-caption] observed cycling ['✦ CREATIVITY GATEWAY', '✦ WORK GATEWAY', '✦ HOME GATEWAY'] (3 unique names captured before video ended; caption updates each PORTAL_GAP=0.95s to the latest gateway). Auto hub transition renders 'Seven worlds, one presence.' at ~29s. Greeting network requests fire from index.tsx: GET /api/guardian/greeting (200) followed by GET /api/tts/13bcea0c908e932f6994fdb99e6043d1.mp3 (200 audio/mpeg). AWAKEN THE GATEWAYS tap surfaces the GUARDIAN greeting bubble. Tapping Work gateway navigates to /portal/work with no crashes and portal renders correctly. One-tap judge reset (⟲) with NO confirmation modal hard-resets to '/' and entrance video replays with advancing currentTime (3.42s captured). Direct /hub renders hub without entrance AND does NOT fire /api/guardian/greeting (greet prop correctly scoped to index.tsx). Console is QUIET — zero 'shadowColor', 'textShadow', or 'props.pointerEvents' deprecation warnings captured across the full flow. grep across /app/frontend/components + /app/frontend/app confirms no leftover deprecated style props. Glow refactor via glow()/textGlow() helpers in /app/frontend/lib/staarwardd/shadow.ts is functional and visually intact — gateway rings still show colored glows in the screenshot.

critical_code_review_comments: shadow.ts glow()/textGlow() correctly branches Platform.OS==='web' to boxShadow/textShadow strings and keeps native shadow*/textShadow* props for iOS/Android — clean, minimal helper.

launch-sequence.tsx line 225 caption text uses PORTALS[min(portalCount, len)-1].label — because portalCount is monotonically increasing (never reset per gateway), the caption always shows the LATEST summoned gateway. It effectively 'cycles' because portalCount advances every PORTAL_GAP=0.95s. Verified empirically (3 unique names captured in test window before video ended).

index.tsx line 30 passes greet only when the LaunchSequence has completed (i.e. entrance path). Direct /hub never routes through IndexScreen so greet is never true — confirmed no /api/guardian/greeting request fires on direct /hub.
Judge Reset is confirmed ONE-TAP (no modal) — [data-testid=judge-reset-btn] tap immediately clears storage and returns to '/' with the entrance video replaying with advancing currentTime.

Zero deprecated-style-prop console warnings and zero grep hits for shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset/textShadowColor/textShadowRadius/textShadowOffset/pointerEvents= JSX props across /app/frontend/components + /app/frontend/app — glow refactor is complete.
seed_data_creation: None. Only side-effect is TTS cache row keyed by SHA-256 of the greeting text (idempotent and shared across all users).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new features work: caption strip cycles gateway names in the final ~8s, Onyx greeting fetches (/api/guardian/greeting → /api/tts/<key>.mp3) fire only from index.tsx (never from direct /hub), and the glow()/textGlow() helpers in /app/frontend/lib/staarwardd/shadow.ts silenced every RN-Web deprecated-style-prop warning. Judge Reset is now one-tap (no confirmation modal — do NOT look for [data-testid=judge-reset-confirm]). Playwright's Chromium picks the .webm fallback (currentSrc contains guardian-toronto-traverse-hd.webm) — this is expected. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_greeting_tts.py is idempotent and can be re-run. Do NOT modify metro.config.js, app.json, or .env.
